property_summary: Calling createArtFromFactory with some artId and sending msg.value causes c.getTokenIdFromFactoryArtId(artId) to equal the returned tokenId and increases tokenIdCounter by exactly 1, and any excess ETH (msg.value - artCreateFee) is returned to this contract (so address(this).balance increases by that excess).
createArtFromFactory increments tokenIdCounter by 1 and sets getTokenIdFromFactoryArtId(artId) to a nonzero token id when called by the factory.
Calling createArtFromFactory by the factory sets getTokenIdFromFactoryArtId(artId) to a nonzero token id (the return) and increases tokenIdCounter by at least 1.
